"Stalker" will participate the Shanghai's CP26 on July 25! ! !
notes.content:
NetBit @UW’s "Stalker (Tailor)" will be exhibiting at the Shanghai CP26 on July 25th.
♪ Zone: Chinese AVG game zone♪
♪ Booth Number: F80♪
♪ Booth name: NetBit @UW♪
♪ Project Name: Stalker♪

⊳Due to the virus, the members of the production team failed to return to the China. Thus, our team's friends will participate instead of us.

⊳ We will participate Day 1 (July 25th). Gifts will be provided at the booth.

Events!
⊳The producer's Weibo is carrying out the Steam CDKey of "Stalker (follower)", drawing 20 people and sending two CDKey to each person! For details, please see [Transfer+Draw]Draw 20 digits to send two CDKey on August 1st .

⊳Weibo of the ACG Shouzhang also has a lottery. For details, please see  [Transfer + draw] Follow and forward...
